title: The leaves on the ramp
logline: Maple leaves on Gully's ramp, yellow, and the girl, thirteen, sweeping them down it toward the dock, from behind. The ramp's first autumn as hers to sweep.

panels.composition: Yellow maple leaves on a plank ramp at a shingle shack's door with a thirteen-year-old girl from behind sweeping them down it toward the dock.
